feature: Customer Portal v2 -- Operate -> Remediation Tracker (/portal-v2/remediation), WIRED TO REAL DATA. The page's markup is still the prototype's `isRemediation` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 5961-6012) and its `rtRun` derivation (20380-20441), but every state fact on it now comes from the calling customer's own `remediation_tracker_steps` rows over GET /api/portal/remediation-tracker (customer-scoped off the JWT's customerId), read through the same `useRemediationTracker` client the Full Remediation Guide writes with. The design task ids (p1a-p3h) are mapped onto the platform's step ids (s1-s23, s26-s30) in remediationLive.ts. The finding CATALOGUE -- titles, scan evidence, severity, pillar, RACI owner -- is still the design's fixture, because the platform holds no per-customer source for it.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/remediation. App.tsx declares it BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it -- Remediation is a plain, param-free route.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree; deploy before running this.

PERSISTED-SESSION FLAKE (known): when WebView2 is already authed, the login FORM never renders, so the three steps that touch it -- the 'wait for #email' expect and the two #email/#password inputs -- fail while everything after them runs green, because the session is already valid. Observed exactly that on the 2026-08-21 run: 42/45, with those three the only red. N-3 of N with only those three red is a PASS for the feature; any RT* step going red is not.

STATUS vs VERIFICATION -- THE LOAD-BEARING ASSERTION. RT7 asserts the 'Fixed and verified' counter reads 0. It reads 0 because NO row for this customer carries verificationState='verified' -- and that value can only ever be produced by reverifyRemediationTrackerSteps() running inside a real scan. The page has no other path to it: remediationData.ts no longer carries a `done` or `verified` field at all, so there is nothing in the fixture, a tick or a filter that could promote a step. If a future edit re-introduces one, RT7 and RT13 go red.

REAL DATA THIS ASSERTS AGAINST (tenant_id 1, the TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL account, read live 2026-08-21 via shaneapp://executeSql): nine stored rows -- s6, s8, s9, s11, s13 are status='completed' with verification_state='drift' (verified_at 2026-08-18), and s1, s26, s27, s30 are status='not_started'/'unverified'. The other 21 steps have no row at all, which the client resolves as not_started. Hence 0 fixed, 30 still to do, and exactly five rows reading 'Drifted'.

THE DRIFT MAPPING IS DELIBERATE. A step the scan CONTRADICTED is not folded back into 'Awaiting re-scan' (that would claim the proof merely hasn't landed when contrary proof has) and is not promoted to Verified. It reads 'Drifted' in the critical tone and counts under 'Still to do'. The design draws four counters and its copy is final, so drift gets an honest row badge rather than a fifth card the design never specified. RT14/RT15 pin that.

IF THE TENANT'S REAL ROWS CHANGE, THE NUMERIC STEPS MOVE. RT2/RT4/RT5/RT7-RT10 are computed from live rows, not typed -- that is the point. A future re-scan that verifies s6 would flip RT14 and raise the verified counter, and this manifest's expectations must be re-pinned from the DB rather than 'fixed' by editing the page.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

apiTests.name: SETUP -- log in as the designated TESTBED account; extract the bearer.
API1 -- the tracker route is genuinely access-gated: no bearer, no data. Proves the page's numbers are customer-scoped rather than public.
API2 -- authenticated, the route returns this customer's own stored steps.

API3 -- ...and carries the phase-gated live pricing computed by remediation-tracker-pricing.ts off those same rows. Pinning it here is what proves the wiring reuses that module rather than growing a second pricing path.

uiSteps.name: goto the real login URL (outer WouterRouter base = '/portal').
WAIT for the login form to hydrate before typing.
Primary login -- every assertion below needs a real session.
goto the Remediation Tracker on its slug-scoped route.
RT1 -- REAL DATA LANDED: the root carries data-rt-loaded='true', which is only set once a payload has actually come back from /api/portal/remediation-tracker.
RT2 -- ...and data-rt-error='false', so the numbers below are the customer's real rows and not a silently-failed read rendering as zeroes.
RT3 -- the headline is COMPUTED from those rows: nothing is fixed for this tenant, because the five claimed steps all drifted back.
uiSteps.textContains: 0 of 30 things fixed since the first scan.

uiSteps.name: RT4 -- the sub states the page's argument, verbatim.
uiSteps.textContains: Nothing here is a project plan

uiSteps.name: RT5 -- the progress bar reads 0 percent.
RT7 -- LOAD-BEARING: the Fixed-and-verified counter is present and reads 0. No row for this customer is verificationState='verified', and only a real scan could make one.

uiSteps.name: RT8 -- the Done-awaiting-re-scan counter is present (0 -- the five claims were all contradicted, so none is merely awaiting proof).

uiSteps.name: RT14 -- p1a maps to step s1, whose REAL stored status is not_started, so it reads 'Not started' -- never 'Verified'.

RT15 -- p1f maps to s6, whose REAL row is completed + verification_state='drift'. It reads 'Drifted' -- the scan contradicted the claim, so the page neither verifies it nor hides it as awaiting proof.
RT16 -- p1k maps to s11, also drifted. A second row proves RT15 is reading data, not a one-off.
RT17 -- p1m maps to s13, drifted too.
RT18 -- p1h is Shane-run AND drifted, so its change-request badge is WITHDRAWN along with the claim: no CR chip on that row.
RT19 -- p1a is Shane-run, so its route reads 'We run it' regardless of status.
RT20 -- p1a is not_started, so it carries no CR badge either (a CR needs a live claim).
RT21 -- an open critical task (p1d) reads 'Not started'.
RT22 -- ...and routes to a Runbook (critical, not Shane-run).
RT23 -- an open attention task (p1b) routes to 'Your team'.
RT24 -- p1a's owner chip shows the governance responsible owner's initials.
RT25 -- the Security group renders too.
RT26 -- and the Compliance group.

RT28 -- LOAD-BEARING: filtering to Verified shows NOTHING. A filter cannot promote a step -- not even the five that were claimed complete.

RT30 -- click Verified again to clear the filter.
RT31 -- the Governance group is back.
RT32 -- filter to Still-to-do: every one of the 30 is there, so Compliance survives the filter.
RT33 -- ...including the drifted p1f, which counts as still to do.
